scene_analysis.scene_overview: A view of a living room with a brown couch, striped chairs, and a large gold wall behind it. The room has a glass wall on the left side with writing on it. There is a black sign with yellow writing on the glass wall. The couch is against the wall and has several pillows on it. There is a pink chair in front of the glass wall. There is a table in front of the couch with a rug on it. The floor is made of concrete. The ceiling is black and there are lights on it. The walls are white. The overall atmosphere is bright and clean.
